title: Attach source markdown as evidence on synced guide pages
description: Follow-up to the (executed, QA-in-progress) Confluence guide-authoring plan: sync_guide currently discards the original markdown after converting it to Confluence storage format, so there's no exact-fidelity copy of what was actually authored. This plan has sync_guide attach the source .md as a file attachment on the guide's own leaf page (not a replacement for the rendered page, and not a change to the index's page-link shape) — pure reference/evidence, re-uploaded as a new attachment version on every sync.
